record.title: Rwanda national COVID passenger border restrictions
record.movement: Ordinary passengers; goods and returning citizens/residents exempt.
record.exceptions: Cargo, returning citizens and legal residents subject to quarantine; later local trading arrangements.
record.enforcement: Passenger bus observed crossing Rwanda to Uganda at Gatuna 7 March 2022; no Rwanda-bound passenger vehicle by17:00.
record.context: Effective at 23:59 on 21 March; phased crossing/group exceptions before national reopening.
record.uncertainty: National policy dates do not represent continuous complete shutdown at every crossing. Rubavu–Goma couriers resumed 5 November 2020. March 2022 is general reopening; pandemic overlap with GL01/GL02 must not be double-counted. The national endpoint is a policy permission; operational resumption is observed only at the specified crossing.

historical.duration_note: Formal change of permission; operational reopening and continuous effective duration not established

followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the included Rwanda national land-passenger policy segment. Goods, returning residents and selected later cohorts were exceptions, so this is not a finding of zero land traffic. The selected ordinary-passenger policy is Rwandan-side. DRC couriers, eligible students/medical travellers and other documented exemptions do not become universal reopening, and Burundi-side admission cannot be inferred. Retain the formal policy segment from 21 March 2020 to 7 March 2022, 716 calendar-date days. July 2020 official continuation and selected November exceptions support qualified policy continuity; it is not a complete operational spell at all posts. Health and biosecurity / Human disease control is explicitly attributed to the public-health measures. No unreported rationale is introduced. The WHO statement, Cabinet decision and named-post reopening/exception accounts were read. Their announcement, policy and traffic-observation roles are distinguished; the Reuters courier republication is one origin. The current phase and location rows are unlocated with null coordinates. No national outline or crossing point is approved from narrative mentions alone. The separate challenge narrows the November resident category to resident officials and corrects two source paraphrases; policy dates and all numeric values are unchanged.

Completion describes the audit procedure for this sample, not proof that unknown attributes or every database record are verified.
